approval_evidence: Researcher requested 15 communes and approved A: seasonally adjusted trends, 36 pre-months and all available post months, reproducible random illustration sample
selection_rule: numpy default_rng choice without replacement of 15 IDs from the 76 calculable exposed territories sorted by analytical BFS ID; freeze and verify IDs, never select by effect or slope
post_rule: all actual observed follow-up months through each territory last available outcome; show missing calendar months as gaps
trend_rule: reuse approved focal-cohort pre36 log1p monthly season coefficients; center them over 12 months; fit separate intercept/calendar slope regressions on seasonally adjusted log1p values before and after; display expm1 fitted curves in night units without smearing or claiming an arithmetic mean
seasonality_after_entry: same pre-entry profile retained; no post-entry refitting of seasonal coefficients
